title: Every Press book can now have an online companion
summary: Worksheets, field tools, coaching guides and sources that belong on a screen now live at a stable address beside each book, starting with The Code Takes Care of Itself.
text: A companion holds what readers fill in, print or bring to a meeting instead of reading in print, and it can include downloads and framed interactive pages. Its pages cite chapters by current title, and each book's What's new says when a companion gains material.
